My break-even is $6.10, so $7.00 would still give me some profit. But at $1.60, I'd be losing $4.50 per unit. Since they showed no reciprocity despite my multiple concessions, and this is the last round, I should stick to my final position. There's no point accepting a terrible deal when they've demonstrated bad faith negotiation.

I need to clearly state we can't proceed and maintain my $7.00 price one last time. The tone should be firm but professional - we're at an impasse because of their unwillingness to negotiate seriously.
